coverageNote: The registry is expandable by district; a college is added only after its official HTTPS domain is verified. Google/search results are discovery aids, never publication evidence.
verificationRule: Only entries with approved=true and collectionStatus=discovery_only are collected; all other sources remain blocked.
userSuppliedDomainsNote: Supplied domains are treated as discovery leads. Only approved=true and collectionStatus=discovery_only sources are collected; blocked entries cannot publish records.
